name: trait Allocator
rule: Memory blocks currently allocated by an allocator must point to valid memory and remain valid until the block is deallocated or the allocator is dropped. A block is currently allocated when its starting address was previously returned by allocate, grow, or shrink and it has not subsequently been deallocated; deallocate and successful grow or shrink calls deallocate the block, while grow or shrink calls returning Err do not.
expression: No faithful DSL expression exists: the grammar exposes only opaque `$1`, with no blocks, allocation history, or temporal predicates.
